concepts.label: Sub-Document MUTATEIN operation
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - minted within this same round in eventing-handler-advancedMutateInField.json (this page's sibling); here demonstrated via MutateInSpec.arrayAppend() against an array field rather than insert/replace/remove against a scalar field

relations.subject: server/8.0/eventing/eventing-handler-advancedMutateInArray
relations.evidence: For more information about the Advanced Sub-Document MUTATEIN operation, see [Sub-Document MUTATEIN Operation](eventing-advanced-keyspace-accessors.md#advanced-subdoc-array-op-mutatein).

notable_absence.finding: 'Running the Function adds 4,495 landmark names to an array without conflict and in no particular order' documents that MutateInSpec.arrayAppend() is safe under concurrent workers (the page sets 18 parallel workers) without any CAS coordination on the caller's part - i.e. the append itself is server-side atomic per-call. No existing predicate captures 'safe under concurrent callers without explicit coordination'; recorded as a finding rather than forced into tradesOffAgainst or a similar relation whose shape doesn't quite fit. Demonstrates the identical eventing:mutatein-subdocument-operation mechanism as advancedMutateInField.json, applied to an array path instead of a scalar path - no separate mechanism, consistent with round 8's own thin, no-mint call for this specific page's array-append example.
